lessons.claim: Six-rung least-squares fit of gamma(dz) = gamma_0/(1 - 9a/(16(dz+h0))) with the MEASURED per-rung error returns h0 to sigma = 0.433-0.450 um, stable across injected h0 of 0.5, 1.0 and 2.0 um (n = 192 ladders each). The claim it replaces is +/- 0.195 um from a 400-realisation numpy model assuming 3 % per rung, so the real scatter is 2.2x the target. gamma_bulk comes back at sd 4.6-5.1 % against a claimed 2.1 %. The fit bias on h0 is <= 0.11 um, smaller than the scatter and h0-dependent, so scatter and not bias is the failure mode. A uniform multiplicative bias on gamma hits gamma_0 and NOT h0 (camera on 1.106, camera off 1.136 at h0_true = 1.0), because h0 is set by the SHAPE of gamma(h).
